I am Tumelo Tshana Konaite, a Data Scientist, AI Engineer, and Software Engineer based in Gauteng, South Africa. With 6 years of experience, I focus on building data-driven products, machine learning solutions, and production-grade AI systems.

I hold an MSc in Computational and Applied Mathematics from the University of the Witwatersrand, where I specialized in areas such as interest rate derivatives and quantitative finance. My passion lies in designing and developing scalable software systems that leverage data and AI to solve real-world business problems.

My work covers a broad spectrum of technologies, including Python, SQL, FastAPI, React, and various cloud services like AWS and GCP. I enjoy operating throughout the entire lifecycle of AI and software development, from data acquisition and analytics to machine learning, backend engineering, deployment, and production operations.

I'm particularly interested in creating intelligent software products and systems that drive measurable business value and have worked on projects ranging from AI-assisted tourism platforms to clinical intake systems. 

If you have any specific questions about my background, projects, or skills, feel free to ask!
